text.p: All base metals remained steady in narrow price ranges on the Indian market, dealers said.
Sluggish industrial demand was offset by limited arrivals of imported metals, they said.

Local supplies remained low too due to lower than expected offerings by the state-owned agencies, notably Hindustan Copper and Hindustan Zinc Ltd. Zinc was steady at 7,450 rupees per quintal. It was down by 50 rupees on Monday.
Copper was quiet at 13,350 rupees, as was aluminium at 7,400 rupees and lead at 4,525 rupees per quintal amid nominal trading.
Tin was steady at the lower level of 31,500 rupees per quintal. Tin was down by 800 rupees during last week and by 2,800 rupees during the last two weeks.
Nickel was unchanged at 37,300 rupees per quintal.
